newsitem.title: USA: Sprint adds six cities to PCS network.
newsitem.headline: Sprint adds six cities to PCS network.

text.p: Sprint Corp said Tuesday it added six cities to its roster of Personal Communications Services (PCS) wireless-capable areas.
The company said it launched digital wireless PCS communications in Salt Lake City; Tulsa and Oklahoma City, Oklahoma; Little Rock, Arkansas; Des Moines, Iowa and the Rio Grande Valley in Texas.
Today also marks the first time Sprint PCS has used Code Division Multiple Access (CDMA) network equipment, the comapny said.
Sprint first launched PCS service in December.
Its shares were trading up 3/4 Tuesday at 45-1/8.
